real_defects_found.what: spy_refresh_pm_r1, spy_refresh_pm_r2 and spy_last_chance_pre_nkd were unclassified in route_classification
real_defects_found.how_it_surfaced: exactly as the module intended - its comment says an unnamed job lands in unclassified and turns the Stage 5L test red
real_defects_found.cost: none to safety: legacy_retirement_candidates returns only the legacy_entry bucket, so an unclassified job was never removable and never inflated the legacy count
real_defects_found.fix: declared as shared_infra in track1_slots.SHARED_INFRA_JOBS, and by hand in the 5L REQUIRED_SURVIVORS list which deliberately does not derive from it

real_defects_found.what: the dashboard schedule mirror does not model those same three jobs
real_defects_found.evidence: schedule_status.py:181 lists only SPY_REFRESH_PM; parity_report returns only_in_scheduler = ['spy_last_chance_pre_nkd','spy_refresh_pm_r1','spy_refresh_pm_r2']
real_defects_found.consequence: three jobs run nightly and the schedule panel has no row to report them late or missing
real_defects_found.why_not_fixed_here: different subsystem, and a row for a job that does not fire when expected creates a permanently-red alarm - the failure mode this project has already paid for. Needs its own stage with the cron times measured.
real_defects_found.status: the two parity tests are left RED so the alarm keeps ringing; they were red before this stage

new_post_b1_invariants.invariant: orders are impossible and something MEASURED holds them
B1 closed requires a signature - remove it and B1 returns
B1 closed requires a measurement - fail the composite while signed and B1 returns
no signature and no environment variable can release what is holding orders
new_post_b1_invariants.note: never sets TRACK1_ORDERS_APPROVED; asserts every holding blocker is a MEASURED_GATE with released_by == () and that the registry does not read the environment

new_post_b1_invariants.invariant: a confirmation on disk must be signed and must not imply orders_possible
the confirmation file alone does NOT refuse a shadow start
a confirmation PLUS every order blocker clear still does refuse
a legacy entry start is refused while the decision says legacy retired, and the refusal names the mode that IS allowed
shared-infra membership is exact in both directions against the PRODUCTION classifier
nothing is unclassified, and the counts are derived from the tables rather than pinned

mutations.copy_rationale: run_scheduler.py is a runtime trading file this stage may not edit; a killed process would leave the live scheduler's own module broken on disk. The real file's digest is checked before and after.

retargeted_after_an_honest_green.why_green: the suite asserted only that the SIGNATURE is necessary; B1 reappears unsigned whatever the measurement says, so one half of the rule was asserted twice
retargeted_after_an_honest_green.response: added test_28b and retargeted M1 at the place a signed gate consults its required measurement

retargeted_after_an_honest_green.first_target: open orders when TRACK1_ORDERS_APPROVED is set
retargeted_after_an_honest_green.why_green: every test asserted the variable was UNSET and none asserted what happens if it is set
once the three rungs were declared no registered job reaches that line, so the edit was to unreachable code - a mutation that never ran, not a passing test
retargeted_after_an_honest_green.response: retargeted at the opposite direction: every job bucketed as shared whether declared or not

my_own_error_caught_by_a_test.what: asserted conf.get('confirmed_by'), but confirmed_by is an attribute of Confirmations, not one of its flags
